revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY23-25 revenue CAGR was ~1.3%; modest pricing/volume recovery to ~3-3.5%, fading to 3% as mature staples business.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: between FY2025 margin 12.2% (11,498/93,925) and FY2024 14.0% and FY2023 13.1%; partial recovery to ~13%.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approx. PepsiCo long-run effective rate ~20%, below the 21% US statutory rate due to foreign mix; not taken from a tool result, reviewer to verify against 10-K tax note.

capex_pct_revenue.source: FY2025 capex 4,415 / revenue 93,925 = 4.70%; below FY23-24 (~5.8%) but kept at the latest level.

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + relevered beta 0.67 (Damodaran Beverage (Soft) unlevered cash-corrected 0.575, D/E 0.206, tax 21%) x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = Ke 7.8%; pre-tax Kd 5.29% (Damodaran) after tax ~4.2%; weights 83/17 (industry D/E) gives ~7.2%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below long-run nominal US GDP growth and below the 4.86% risk-free rate; typical for mature consumer staples.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt = total debt 49,182 (LT noncurrent 42,321 + current 6,861) - cash 9,159 - ST investments 371; 10-K 0000077476-26-000007
